514:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...With half of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces gone in one stroke, $$フロンタル$$'s bound to make a move, of course.」

514:t_1:5.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$スメラギ$$ and the others think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will press $$ザフト$$ to hand over all its forces.」

514:t_1:6.en:
$$マリー$$
「And we're headed to $$プラント$$ to keep that in check.」

514:t_1:7.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So what's $$ザフト$$ up to? They seem to be turning up for the skirmishes, but we've barely run into them.」

514:t_1:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ザフト$$ promised its cooperation, but it's apparently staying cautious about providing forces.」

514:t_1:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Not that it needed to, I suppose. $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces are overwhelming in space, so there were few occasions when $$ザフト$$ was asked to deploy.」

514:t_1:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I wonder if holding back its forces is the top brass's decision...」

514:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The head of $$ザフト$$... Defense Committee Chairman $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$...」

514:t_1:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So that $$レイ#pt136$$ is $$ザフト$$'s commander...」

514:t_1:14.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I get the history of the $$コーディネイター$$s, but that still doesn't mean I can accept selling Earth out to the $$サイデリアル$$.」

514:t_1:19.en:
$n
「$$スメラギ$$ has decided to send an infiltration team to investigate the situation in $$プラント$$.」

514:t_1:20.en:
$$キラ$$
「Sitting here hugging your knees won't change anything. Come with us, $$シン$$.」

514:t_1:22.en:
$$キラ$$
「What do you want to do, $$シン$$?」

514:t_1:24.en:
$$シン$$
「I want to see $$レイ#pt136$$ and talk to him.」

514:t_1:26.en:
$$シン$$
「...The truth is, I'm... scared. When I think that $$レイ#pt136$$ might have changed...」

514:t_1:28.en:
$$キラ$$
「I understand how you feel, $$シン$$.」

514:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Just think about meeting him. The rest of us will support you.」

514:t_1:31.en:
$n
「Don't thank me. We owe each other.」

514:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Let me say it anyway. Thanks.」

514:t_1:33.en:
$n
「Save that for after the infiltration goes well.」

514:t_1:34.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Be careful, $$シン$$. You too, $$キラ$$ and $n.」

514:t_1:35.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「All of us will handle the diversion.」

514:t_1:36.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Once you've slipped into $$プラント$$, we'll back you up.」

514:t_1:38.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course, I'm coming too. I'm worried about $$メイリン$$ as well.」

514:t_1:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So there's still no word on $$ラクス$$, $$バルトフェルド$$ and the others...」

514:t_1:40.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's all right, $$カミーユ$$. $$アスラン$$ is with $$ラクス$$ and the others.」

514:t_1:41.en:
$$キラ$$
「So, $$シン$$... first, let's go see $$レイ#pt136$$.」

514:t_1:43.en:
$$シン$$
($$レイ#pt136$$... Thanks to everyone, we've become able to decide for ourselves how we live.)

514:t_1:44.en:
$$シン$$
(Everyone is helping me again... So I'll save you, $$レイ#pt136$$.)

514:t_2:3.en: ～ $$プラント$$ Defense Committee Chairman's Office ～

514:t_2:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「They're on the offensive as well. This war will be heading toward its conclusion.」

514:t_2:6.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「You want $$ザフト$$ to move too?」

514:t_2:8.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「We've already dispatched several units. Any more would leave $$プラント$$'s defenses thin.」

514:t_2:9.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$レイ・ザ・バレル$$... I understand your wish to protect the people of $$プラント$$.」

514:t_2:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But unless the world's very nature is changed, $$コーディネイター$$s will forever be treated as monsters of space.」

514:t_2:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Have you forgotten the bitter regret of 《$$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$》?」

514:t_2:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s are victims of $$クロノ$$, but you and he are the dark side that $$クロノ$$ blood gave birth to.」

514:t_2:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A man born into the $$クロノ$$ line sought greater power for his clan, and built a sacrifice to be his successor: $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$...」

514:t_2:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And then you, who were his spare...」

514:t_2:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...You, too, were given a role from birth.」

514:t_2:18.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is why I could understand $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$, and why I sympathized with the ideals of Chairman $$デュランダル$$, his friend.」

514:t_2:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Though back then, I never imagined that I would stand on the stage of history.」

514:t_2:20.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$ギル$$ tried to build a world that accepts a fate decided at birth...」

514:t_2:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「《$$デスティニープラン$$》... If everyone in the world were given a mission as we were, it could be called the most efficient way.」

514:t_2:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Though in the $$多元戦争$$, many people rejected it.」

514:t_2:24.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Looking back at the world as it stands, it was precisely the means of creating a future. That is why I became your collaborator.」

514:t_2:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm grateful, $$レイ#pt136$$. Precisely because you were a former $$ザフト$$ $$赤服$$ close to the Chairman, you could become Defense Committee Chairman, though I did give you a push.」

514:t_2:26.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Please hurry your answer on a full-scale $$ザフト$$ deployment. For now, I'm counting on you to deal with $c.」

514:t_2:28.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The true purpose of your $$デスティニープラン$$... I will surely fulfill it.」

514:t_2:32.en: ～ $$プラント$$ - $$アプリリウス市$$ Hidden Passage ～

514:t_2:33.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Once we're this far, it's a straight shot from here.」

514:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「$$デュオ$$, $$刹那$$ and the others are running the diversion outside. Let's hurry.」

514:t_2:37.en:
$n
「Footsteps are approaching. $$キラ$$, you and the others go ahead.」

514:t_2:38.en:
$$シン$$
「You're saying you'll hold them off all by yourself?」

514:t_2:39.en:
$n
「I've got Jeet Kune Do and $$ブーストアップ$$. And if it comes to it, I'll call $$ジェニオン$$.」

514:t_2:40.en:
$$キラ$$
「All right. We're leaving this to you.」

514:t_2:42.en:
$n
(Don't worry, $$シン$$. I don't intend to end in a place like this, either.)

514:t_2:43.en:
$n
(The footsteps have gotten louder... Here they come...!)
